comment: POSTGAME.md P4d, the lamp, the Door and the Stair. Sir Dunstable before and after the ending: never met, introduced and the lamp lent (trope); again, in no hurry. The Door with the lamp: in, at the top of the Stair, in the dark but for the lamp. The schedule. The first flight walked on foot; D. 2. Down off one map onto the next and back up. The warden: lost, which is back in through the porch restored with the lamp (the trope, and no Quillon beat unsigned), Dunstable knowing it; then won, out of the way. A random encounter lost on the Stair with the Book signed: the porch, and Quillon not looking up. D. 212 and its trope; past it, not yet. And a battle lost on the world map is still Game Over.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; window._mark = () => { window._lines = []; window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); }; window._mark(); window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s)); window._dt = () => $gameVariables.value(2) - window._tropes;
window._auto = false; const t = Window_Message.prototype.isTriggered; Window_Message.prototype.isTriggered = function () { return window._auto || t.call(this); };

steps.label: before the ending: Sir Dunstable is his first page, and nobody has the lamp
no lamplight in the chapel
after it, he has a page with the lamp on it
walked up to him and spoke

steps.label: never met: introduced (and the trope), then the lamp, lent

steps.check: [$gameMap.event(4).findProperPageIndex(), window._has('Lamp all right?'), window._has('Came in by the porch'), window._dt()]

the Door has a page for a party with a lamp

dark but for the lamp, and continuance on

down the first flight on foot
D. 2, chalked on the wall above the hall
down off the bottom of the first map onto the second
and back up onto the first
the warden stops you, and the fight is the warden
